issues.title: seeds dedupe: native tracker heal command (report + --write, gate-friendly)
issues.description:
Native command: `seeds dedupe` — heal duplicated tracker records
(beyond sd parity; ADR-0023 additive own-development, demanded by the
2026-09-26 fabro tracker-corruption incident: sd sync's wholesale
rewrite makes issues.jsonl merge-hostile, git line-merges produced 596
duplicate ids on the fabro line via run-PR squashes; the ad-hoc python
union recipe ran four times in one session).

SEMANTICS (reference recipe, commit denkhaus/fabro e58fd06e8):
- One record per id: keep the record with the NEWEST updatedAt (tie:
  later line position wins); preserve first-seen line order otherwise.
- Operates on .seeds/issues.jsonl AND plans.jsonl / templates.jsonl
  (same record-id rule per file).

CLI SHAPE:
- `seeds dedupe` — report mode: prints per-file duplicate summary
  (id, count, kept updatedAt, dropped updatedAts) and EXITS 1 when
  duplicates exist, 0 when clean. CI/gate-friendly: usable directly as
  a qualitygate battery.
- `seeds dedupe --write` — applies the heal in place (atomic temp-file
  + rename), prints the recipe summary, exits 0; idempotent (clean file
  = no-op, exit 0).
- `seeds dedupe --json` — machine-readable report for the loop scripts.

INTEGRATION DEMANDS (cross-repo):
- fabro's fabro-4cfc guard (qualitygate duplicate-id battery +
  push-gate HEAD check) should CALL `seeds dedupe` once this lands,
  replacing the ad-hoc python recipe (bootstrap: the python recipe
  stays until the CLI parity surface ships).
- Later surface: `fabro seeds dedupe` (subcommand integration per
  ADR-0023 fabro-seeds wiring).
- Adjacent follow-up (NOT this seed): canonical-order write mode
  (sorted, append-friendly serialization) to make merges trivial —
  separate seed once the format core settles.

ACCEPTANCE:
- Fixture with duplicated ids: report mode exits 1 with correct
  summary; --write produces the union-newest single-record file
  (byte-verified against the recipe's output for the same fixture).
- sd 0.5.15 reads the healed file unchanged (round-trip suite green).
- Clean file: both modes exit 0, no rewrite (--write must not touch
  an already-clean file).

issues.title: real_fixture test: volatile-field drift breaks PR #1 CI (fixture vs moving tracker)
issues.description:
PR #1 (format core) is CI-red on one test: real_fixture
`our_reader_agrees_with_sd_on_every_repo_record` —
`field updatedAt of seeds-facc differs between sd and our reader`
(fixture 2026-09-20T17:52:48Z vs repo file 14:06:18Z). 15/16 green.

ROOT CAUSE (diagnosed from the CI log): the checked-in fixture
(tests/fixtures/repo_issues_sd_list.json) was captured DURING the run,
after the run's own sd experiments/claim had bumped tracker state; the
tracker file on the PR branch carries older values. The test design
compares a static snapshot against a MOVING target — any run that
mutates the tracker between fixture capture and CI breaks it.

FIX DEMAND: make the real-fixture equivalence test insensitive to
volatile fields — compare per record only stable fields (id, title,
type, priority, labels, blockedBy) and normalize/exclude volatile ones
(updatedAt, status, assignee) — or regenerate the fixture from the
branch's own tracker in a prepare step. The volatile-field set belongs
in one named constant with a comment explaining the drift class.

NOTE: this blocks PR #1 (first seeds merge) — the fix must land ON the
PR branch (run branch fabro/run/01M2ZYVQ7CBS...), not on main, because
main does not carry the format core yet.

issues.title: Self-hosting cutover: replace sd with the seeds binary in this repo's develop loop
issues.description:
Self-hosting cutover (ADR-0023 bootstrap doctrine): this repo's develop
loop replaces `sd` with the `seeds` binary for ALL tracker operations —
prompts/PROJECT_FACTS command table, .fabro scripts, AGENTS.md, and the
toolchain image drop @os-eco/seeds-cli (mulch CLI stays until the mulch
phase).

Acceptance:
- A full develop cycle on this repo runs green using only `seeds`
- .mise.toml + .fabro/Dockerfile.toolchain no longer install
  @os-eco/seeds-cli
- The round-trip suite still passes against a sd-0.5.15 reference
  checkout kept in the suite fixtures (compat stays proven even after
  the repo stops using sd)

issues.title: CLI parity surface: create/show/list/ready/update/close/dep/prime/search
issues.description:
CLI parity surface over the format core: the binary `seeds` implements
create, show, list, ready, update, close, dep add, prime, search with the
same flags/semantics as sd 0.5.15 (the reference: @os-eco/seeds-cli,
pinned in .mise.toml and the toolchain image).

Acceptance:
- Flag-level parity for the nine commands against sd 0.5.15 (incl.
  --assignee filters, --limit 200 semantics, --format json output shape
  {success, command, issues}, exit-0-on-error behavior of the reference)
- Tracker scripts in .fabro/workflows/develop/scripts/ still work when
  pointed at the new binary (tracker-guard, planner-preflight, closeout
  smoke batteries)

issues.title: Format core: .seeds JSONL reader/writer + round-trip compat suite vs sd 0.5.15
issues.description:
First product seed: the format core everything else builds on.

Deliverables:
- Reader/writer for the .seeds/ store (config.yaml, issues.jsonl,
  plans.jsonl, templates.jsonl) in crates/seeds.
- Data model: seed records with id <project>-<hex4>, title, description,
  status (open/in_progress/closed), type, priority, labels, assignee,
  timestamps, blockedBy dependency arrays.
- Unknown record fields MUST be preserved on every write (read-modify-
  write, verified live against sd 0.5.15: additive fields survive update
  and close).
- Round-trip compat suite: our writer writes, sd 0.5.15 reads + updates,
  our fields survive; and inverse direction. This suite is the crate's
  acceptance gate (README compat contract, ADR-0023 in denkhaus/fabro).

Acceptance:
- cargo nextest green incl. round-trip suite
- `sd show` and our reader agree on every record of this repo's own
  .seeds/issues.jsonl (593-record-scale real fixture is the denkhaus/fabro
  tracker, not this file set — synthetic fixtures plus this tracker)
